name: floor-native
description: Capacitor Android shell for The Floor — loads the GitHub Pages site in a WebView so the app works while Chrome is blocked

scripts.build:apk: node make-icons.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../floor-app-debug.apk
